newsitem.title: USA: KAISER UPS SOFT-ALLOY EXTRUDED ALUMINUM PRICES.
newsitem.headline: KAISER UPS SOFT-ALLOY EXTRUDED ALUMINUM PRICES.

text.p: Kaiser Aluminum & Chemical Corp said Wednesday it was raising prices for its soft-alloy extruded aluminum products, including seamless hollows, by US$0.05 per pound or C$0.15 per kilogram.
The higher prices are effective with orders placed on or after August 15 and with shipments on or after August 25, it said.
Open orders on the book as of August 12 will be increased for shipments scheduled after September 6, it said.
Kaiser, one of the world's leading producers of alumina, primary aluminum and fabricated aluminum products, is a unit of Kaiser Aluminum Corp. MAXXAM Inc holds a 62 percent stake in the parent.
